sweep_notes: Zero phantoms. All five names pre-announced by company press release, and in every case the release also gave the hour — so date and session are both company-sourced for all five and session_unsettled is 0.

Three of five baselines have untrustworthy reaction history: CAN and GMHS badly (6-K text matcher caught non-earnings filings and produced impossible cadences), WDH partially (clean quarterly chain through 2026-03-25, then a three-filing cluster inside one quarter). Only ABM and UNFI, both on exact 8-K item 2.02 acceptance times, give a usable earnings base rate.

The task brief stated all five baselines carry verdict 'fits_cadence'. They do not: CAN and GMHS both carry verdict 'unknown' with cadence_implausible true. In both cases the cadence flag was right that the filing history is not earnings, and wrong to cast doubt on the event — the company releases settle it.

UNFI is the only name with a usable option chain (event-implied ~12.0%, indicative only at a 39%-of-mid ATM spread). The other four have no market-implied move, so any hunter finding on them cannot be sized against what was priced.

The date-relabelling risk flagged in the brief was live: UNFI and ABM both have real September 2025 earnings stories in the index. Every date claim above rests on a 2026 date verified from the URL path or from the fetched document, never from a search snippet.
